cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise SaaS Screen-Recording Auto-Zoom evaluation (capturing a cursor-free 4K clean plate alongside 120Hz OS/DOM interaction telemetry JSON, auto-redacting PII/API keys via regex+OCR masks, smoothing hesitant mouse trajectories into cubic Bezier arcs, driving a critically-damped zeta=1.0 spring camera to 2.4x magnification on active click targets, and compiling 5 synchronized deliverables [4K 16:9 video, 9:16 mobile vertical, interactive HTML sandbox, Markdown docs, GIF] so amortized cost c_saas(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_saas = 1.0000x across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive raw OBS capture + manual After Effects keyframing/masking (which inflates post-production labor by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-frame spring trajectory quadrature.
